coverLetter.subject: Junior Trader application
paragraphs: I would like to apply for the Junior Trader role on the equity derivatives desk at Example Markets. The role is close to the work I do now: executing trades across equities, futures and options, watching P&L and margin through the day, and writing up what happened for the desk.

At Northbridge Capital I execute simulated and live trades under written trade plans, with pre-trade risk checks and position limits applied before every order. I monitor daily P&L, margin and exposure, and my end-of-day summaries flag limit breaches and open risks so that senior traders can act on them quickly.

I also keep my own trade records honest. I built an Excel journal that records the rationale, slippage and outcome of every position, and using it raised the quality of my trade reviews by 25%. Before Northbridge, I wrote weekly sector notes at Kestrel Capital, turning macro data, earnings and price action into short summaries.

My programming is limited to Python (basic), and I would welcome the chance to build on it with the desk's tools. I hold an MSc in Finance and a BSc in Economics, and I would be glad to discuss how I could support your traders from the first week.
